title: Unique Glassy Australian Spring Onions Skillet
description: A kid-friendly Australian dish featuring spring onions in a floral and glassy jelly sauce, made with beurre-monte and FODMAP-friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped spring onions and cook until they are softened.
In a small bowl, whisk together the gelatin and chicken broth until the gelatin is dissolved.
Add the gelatin mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it has thickened into a glassy jelly sauce.
Stir in the beurre-monte, salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has coated the spring onions.
Garnish with edible flowers, if desired.
